archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Adapted to Soft Cloud/Minimalist Tech)
global_vibe: Calm, emotionally intelligent, minimal, elegant, modern, trustworthy, psychologically safe. Private by design.

typography.font_family: Plus Jakarta Sans, Outfit, or Manrope

spacing_and_layout.safe_area_handling: Always wrap main screen content in SafeAreaView. Apply bottom padding for navigation and keyboard avoiding view for inputs.

microphone_orb.description: Central ambient orb acting as the primary interaction point for the Home screen.

visuals.idle: Size 120x120. Background #F0F9FF. Border 1px solid #E0F2FE. Soft drop shadow (blur 24px, color #0EA5E9, opacity 20%).
visuals.active: Gradient background (#38BDF8 to #0EA5E9). Shadow intensity increases.
visuals.icon: Microphone icon inside, colored #0EA5E9 when idle, #FFFFFF when active.

microphone_orb.motion: Continuous slow breathing animation (scale 1.0 to 1.05 over 3s, loop). On press down, scale shrinks to 0.95.

text_field.focus_state: Border changes to #38BDF8, adds soft outer glow.

splash_onboarding.layout: Full screen centered logo and Tagline. Use ambient_background_1.
splash_onboarding.transitions: Crossfade on entry, slow translation upwards.

auth_google.layout: Bottom-heavy layout. Top area clear or showing subtle ambient animation. Bottom sheet container (rounded-t-3xl, bg-white) housing the Google Sign-In button, Trust Badges, and terms.
auth_google.visuals: No aggressive warning text. Use soft checkmarks and 'Encrypted by default' badges.

home_screen.layout: Minimalist center-stage. Top header has minimal profile/settings icon. Absolute center is the Microphone Orb. Below it, muted text 'Speak your phrase'. Bottom safe area has a subtle 'Type instead' secondary button.
home_screen.background: bg-default with very faint radial gradient in the center behind the orb.

room_summon.layout: Appears as a glassmorphism overlay (backdrop blur) over the Home screen. PIN entry dots centered. Minimal keyboard.

create_room.layout: Wizard flow. Step 1: Speak/Type phrase. Step 2: Set PIN. Step 3: Choose Duo/Circle (Card selector). Generous spacing, soft highlight borders on selected cards.

room_chat.header: Clean white header, minimal border-bottom. Shows Room Type icon (Duo/Circle) and a small disappearing timer icon. Top-right 'Force Exit' button.
room_chat.body: Chat list, inverted scrolling. Generous padding between messages.
room_chat.footer: Input container. Minimal text field, rounded-full. Right side: Voice record button, attachment icon (+). Ephemeral hints ('Messages disappear when you leave').

transparency_dashboard.layout: Scrollable View. Stats presented in large soft cards. Large typography for numbers ('0 retained messages'). Calm, reassuring tone. No red text unless an actual risk is detected.

profile_verification.layout: Form layout. Avatar with verified badge (cyan check). Read-only or highly structured input fields to convey safety.

super_admin.layout: List-based. Tab navigation for 'Users', 'Reports', 'Admins'. List items have clear typography, right-aligned action dots. Suspended users have a soft red background tint.

navigation.pattern: Stack navigation for immersive flows (Chat, Room Summon). Hide bottom tabs in Home to maintain minimalism. Use a drawer or secondary modal for Transparency/Profile from the Home screen.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Fluid, unhurried, reassuring. Nothing snaps. Everything fades or slides gently.

accessibility.color_contrast: Verify WCAG AA for all text against backgrounds. The #0EA5E9 primary color has sufficient contrast against white for large text, but for body text use #0284C7 or #0F172A.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48 logical pixels for all touchable elements.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Provide fallback for orb breathing animation if reduced motion is enabled.

testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format to facilitate robust automated testing. Example: data-testid='google-signin-btn'.

logo.description: Consentalk Logo - Blue speech bubble + lock + voice waveform

ambient_background_1.description: Soft abstract bokeh image featuring subtle light patterns.
ambient_background_1.placement: Splash screen background, or heavily blurred as Home screen background base

ambient_background_2.placement: Behind the transparency dashboard or settings screens to maintain the serene aesthetic.

tech_stack_notes: Use React Native (Expo Router) with standard JavaScript files (.js). Style with NativeWind or StyleSheet. Avoid .tsx as per user request. No aggressive hacker/spy styles.
